subject: Re: Kickoff: C-Learning - status before sweep freeze
body:
Status two days before config freeze.

M1 done (landed Jun 2, few days late - the mujoco container saved us, thanks Oyin). C-Learning matches published performance on 5 of 6 MuJoCo manipulation tasks and beats our internal HER-style relabeling baseline on 4, consistent with the paper's claim that it outperforms prior goal-relabeling methods.

For the ablation week: Gustavo's sweep is 6 tasks x 7 goal-sampling ratios x 4 seeds, plus the off-policy track where we evaluate 3 held-out policies against ground-truth Monte Carlo rollouts. Configs freeze Wednesday as planned.

One risk to flag for the integration spec: the off-policy variant's future-state predictions degrade when the new policy is far from the data-collection policy - on our farthest held-out policy the predicted goal-reach probabilities are off by up to 18 points. We'll quantify the "trust radius" during the sweep, but M3 should probably ship with a policy-divergence guardrail rather than unconditional claims.

Halima
